These bored members of the upper classes wage war from mobile fortresses and view the battlefield as their playground. Few in number, the Titan Lords usually offer their services as mercenaries, but on the rare occasions when they fight together, their armies of massive walkers are a spectacle to behold. With little fear of consequences for their actions, Titan Lords often wander from one battlefield to the next, seeking some sort of thrill or purpose that is lacking in their pampered lives. Within a relatively short time, humanity has managed to build up a large industrial base in their colonies throughout the Sirius Sector, and most of these are owned by a handful of powerful companies.... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/titan-lords) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Lustbound: This model gets +4" range when shooting and moves +2" when using Charge actions. ### Special Rules Delayed Action: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later). Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). ### Aura Special Rules Read more ### Spells Combat Ecstasy (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Quick Shot against once (next time the effect would apply). Beautiful Pain (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with Shatter. Blissful Dance (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Melee Evasion once (next time the effect would apply). Total Seizure (2): Pick one enemy model within 18", which takes 4 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. Lust Boon (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Lustbound Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Overpowering Lash (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Shred. ### Units ### Vehicles / Monsters Lust Vassal Micro-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 190pts Heavy Hammer(A1, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A3, AP(1)) Fear(1), Fortified, Lustbound, Tough(9) Lust Errant Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 285pts Heavy Hammer(A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Fortified, Furious, Lustbound, Tough(12) Lust Pilgrim Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 345pts Fusion Blaster(24", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Fortified, Lustbound, Tough(12) Lust Yeoman Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 445pts 2x Fusion Blaster(24", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Lustbound, Relentless, Tough(12) ### Titans Lust Paladin Light Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 475pts Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Heavy Hammer(A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A6, AP(2)) Fear(3), Fortified, Lustbound, Tough(18) Lust Questor Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 680pts Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)), Titan Hammer(A4, AP(1), Blast(3)) Fear(4), Fortified, Furious, Lustbound, Tough(24) Lust Knight Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 810pts Titan Fusion Cannon(24", A2, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)) Fear(4), Fortified, Lustbound, Tough(24) Lust Duke Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 1000pts 2x Titan Fusion Cannon(24", A2, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)) Fear(4), Lustbound, Relentless, Tough(24) Lust King Heavy Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 1085pts Twin Shoulder-Cannon(24", A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), 2x Titan Harpoon Cannon(18", A1, AP(4), Deadly(9)), Twin Hull-Fuser(12", A2, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A10, AP(3)) Fear(4), Lustbound, Tough(30) Images: -
